Subject: Re: Close & Go-Live logistics / questions

Jonas —

Thanks for the demo last week. We’re headed to exec sign-off tomorrow and I wanted to get a practical plan for the two things leadership will ask about: how we validate quality during the first 30 days, and what the rollback/rollback testing looks like if the canary shows regressions.

High level constraints from our side:
- Peak inference windows: 10:00–14:00 PT weekdays.
- We cannot have >500ms p99 latency spikes during those windows.
- Training for our agents needs to be scheduled before ramp (we have 12 trainers).

Can you send a concise implementation plan (timeline + owners) that embeds the MAP, evaluation cadence, and a canary plan? PDF or spreadsheet is fine. Also include any procurement steps we should expect post-signature.

Appreciate it — Alicia

--
Alicia Moreno
Head of Product

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 8 Dec 2025 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Close & Go-Live: Implementation Bridgeplan + Evaluation Cadence

Alicia — thanks, and congrats on the near-final sign-off. I’ve attached an Implementation Bridgeplan (ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx) that folds the mutual action items into a phased timeline. TL;DR below, then the attachment has owners and gates.

Key points (short):
- Week 0 (Day 0–7): Contract signature + procurement handoff (DocuSign link in HS record). Procurement checklist includes SOC 2 addendum and KMS key exchange.
- Week 1: Provisioning & private environment setup (VPC peering + KMS). Redwood ops (Marissa) owns this.
- Week 2: Internal integration + test harness (embedding validation, token accounting). Developer sandbox mirrors production config.
- Week 3: Canary window (2-week rolling canary): start at 5% traffic, monitor quality/eval. Canary schedule is 2x 1-week phases (low to medium traffic), escalation gate after phase 1.
- Week 5: Ramp to prod (50% then 100%) based on evaluation gates.

Evaluation cadence (what we’ll measure):
- Daily: latency p50/p95/p99, token cost per request, error rate.
- Weekly: quality evals using your prompt set (we’ll run pairwise comparisons vs baseline, A/B).
- Regression alerting: threshold = >3% quality delta on weighted metric OR p99 spike >250ms above baseline for 3 consecutive business hours — triggers rollback.

Rollback plan:
- Automated fallback to previous model variant in runtime for immediate mitigation (1–3s).
- If rollback occurs during canary, we’ll pause traffic escalation and run a root-cause replay on the canary traces.
- Post-rollback: retro and patch window (48–72h) before reattempt.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action items + owner table), canary-checklist.pdf (preflight verification), training-curriculum-v1.docx (trainer agenda).

Marissa (ops) and Ben (integrations) are cc’d to confirm resource availability and propose concrete canary windows.

Next actions:
1) Alicia: confirm preferred canary start date (we recommended Mon, 2025-12-22) and training week.
2) Acme procurement: sign DocuSign envelope and provide KMS contact.
3) Redwood ops: begin VPC prep once signatures clear.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short mutual-action checklist extract in the thread.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Looping in a quick ops reality check. Per the attached canary-checklist, we’ll need these preflight items validated before the canary start:
- VPC peering established + cross-account IAM role verified.
- Test harness with replay traces loaded (Marissa owns).
- Monitoring dashboards provisioned (token-level cost + per-route latency).
- Acceptance prompt set ingested into eval runner (Ben to coordinate).

Proposed 2-week cadence:
Phase A (Week 3): 5% traffic, business hours only (10–14 PT). 
Gate: zero critical regressions for 5 business days + A/B quality delta <2%
Phase B (Week 4): 25% traffic, extended hours (08–18 PT). 
Gate: metric stability for 7 days + ops sign-off.

If Alicia confirms Dec 22 start, we’ll run preflight from Dec 15–19 and schedule trainer sessions Dec 17–19 (half-day blocks). I’ll drop calendar invites after Jonas confirms the envelope is returned.

-Marissa
